Comments: NITA-U Act 2009 establishes mandate for e-governance coordination. Data Protection and Privacy Act enacted. e-GIF v2 issued as mandatory standard for all MDAs/LGs. Digital Uganda Vision (DUV) policy framework. Multiple enabling laws confirmed for cross-government data sharing.

revised_comments: Uganda has an established legal basis for cross-government data sharing. The National Information Technology Authority-Uganda (NITA-U) Act No. 4 of 2009 establishes NITA-U's statutory mandate to build and maintain e-government interoperability enablers, including the Secure Data Exchange ecosystem. This is reinforced by the Data Protection and Privacy Act No. 9 of 2019 (with 2021 regulations), the National Databank Regulations 2019, the Electronic Transactions Act 2011, and the e-Government Interoperability Framework (e-GIF), which NITA-U has issued as a mandatory technical standard for all ministries, departments, agencies and local governments. On this legal footing, NITA-U operates UgHub, a data integration platform connecting over 150 government entities for real-time data sharing.
